headline: On last trading day, Sensex fell 571 points and Nifty hit 22,422, ending an eighth straight losing week.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 5 October.

why: Persistent selling pressure from Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs).
A significant 3% decline in the Nifty Auto sector.
Global concerns regarding rising yields and potential AI bubbles.
Weak market sentiment following a record eight-week losing streak.
whatHappening: The Sensex dropped 570.59 points while the Nifty 50 closed at 22,421.95.
Investors lost between Rs 5 trillion and Rs 10 trillion in market capitalization.
The Nifty 50 index briefly slipped below the 22,300 level during intraday trading.
The market recorded its worst losing streak in recent history with an eighth weekly decline.
summary: The Indian stock market concluded its last session with sharp losses, marking the eighth consecutive week of declines for major indices. Heavy selling by foreign institutional investors and a 3% drop in the Auto sector contributed to a significant erosion of market capitalization. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and are scheduled to reopen on Monday, October 5, 2026.
